name: ChatWithCloud - Chat with your AWS Cloud from Terminal
summary: CLI to Chat with your AWS Cloud from Terminal using generative AI.

claims.claim: Homepage publicly accessible and value proposition clearly stated
claims.evidence: ChatWithCloud is a CLI allowing you to interact with AWS Cloud using human language inside your Terminal thanks to generative AI.

claims.claim: Pricing page discoverable in 2 clicks from homepage
claims.evidence: The homepage contains a link to the pricing page labeled 'AWS S3 Pricing Calculator'.

claims.claim: Documentation or live demo accessible without login
claims.evidence: ChatWithCloud can be tried on your own in Terminal, no OpenAI API Key needed.

claims.claim: Integration list or supported frameworks documented
claims.evidence: The homepage lists integration options such as 'npm', 'brew', 'pnpm', and 'Bun'.

claims.claim: Authentication / data handling claims publicly stated
